name: Sensitive Data & Secret Detection (BLOCKING)
description: Tier A blocking variant (PreToolUse, exit 2 on violation): stops a write that would place a hardcoded secret or PII on disk BEFORE it lands. The one genuine blocking hook — a secret on disk can be committed, pushed and mirrored before any gate opens, and that exposure is irreversible, so a gate-fired sensor is too late. Emitted ONLY when the recorded enforcement strength for secrets/PII is `block` AND the platform supports a pre-write blocking hook (strength-to-mechanism.md). Where the platform cannot block pre-write, the advisory sibling sensitive-data-check.json is emitted instead and the limitation is disclosed in PLATFORM_NOTES.md.

patterns: {DERIVE: application code patterns from tech-stack.md + module-structure.md — e.g., src/**/*.cs, src/**/*.ts, src/**/*.json — PLUS root config files: *.env, appsettings*.json, *.yaml. NEVER bare **/*.ext. See common/hook-preamble.md for Layer 2 runtime filter.}

then.command: {DERIVE: the platform's pre-write secret/PII scan command. On exit 2 the write is BLOCKED and stderr is shown to the user; exit 0 allows the write. The check logic is IDENTICAL to the advisory variant's — same patterns (connection strings with passwords; API keys/tokens sk-/xoxb-/ghp_/glpat-/key-/token-; hardcoded credential pairs; private keys/certs; JWT secrets) and the same PII-in-logs check against observability-sensitive.md. See common/hook-preamble.md for the package-territory exclusion (EXIT 0 SILENTLY for excluded zones — never block a package-infrastructure file). Rule IDs: SEC-BASELINE-01 (secrets) + SEC-20/21/22 (PII classes).}
then.exitCodeSemantics: exit 2 = block the write (violation found, stderr forwarded); exit 0 = allow (compliant or excluded zone)

complianceLog.note: On every fire, append to compliance-log/events/{today-date}.jsonl a CHECK event: {"timestamp":"{ISO-8601-UTC}","type":"check","id":"chk-{date}-{time}-{seq}","hook":"sensitive-data-check-blocking","trigger":"PreToolUse","ruleId":"SEC-BASELINE-01","ruleSeverity":"critical","result":"{pass|blocked}","message":"{finding}","sessionDedup":true}. A blocked write logs result=blocked. Logging is non-negotiable even on block (Rule 5).
